actions.name: death burst
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} explodes [[lookup @activation.condition activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]]. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=soAO2jRWos8FsxeU]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=soAO2jRWos8FsxeU]]-foot Cone.
